extDesc.message: Shows your Gmail verification code in a card next to the page. Click to copy. 100% local.

badgeLogin.message: G-Colou: sign in to Gmail in this Chrome

warn.message: Sent by $1, not this site. Check before using it.

move.message: Move the card (drag or use arrow keys)

demoHi.message: Example: drag the ✥ wherever you want

demoFrom.message: release to save · click to close

optEnabledSub.message: Shows the card when a code arrives in Gmail

optNameSub.message: Shown on the card: “Vitor, your code is here”

optAutoSub.message: Only from the site you're on. Others need a click.

optAllSub.message: Reads every account signed in to this Chrome, not just the main one.

optPlaceSub.message: Shows a sample card on the open page. Drag it anywhere: that becomes the default.

optPlaceErr.message: Open a site (https://...) in this tab, reload it and try again.

optSideSub.message: Picking a side resets the dragged position.

optFooter.message: Reads only unread emails from the last 5 min. Nothing leaves your browser.
